_what_this_is: The fixture capability vocabulary. Pack decision 6 — what a capability name IS — remains open and awaiting the project lead; this file exists so the fixture mandates and grants can name capabilities without pretending that question is settled.
comparison: exact string equality only. Containment (does repo.* cover repo.pull-request.create?) is DELIBERATELY UNDEFINED — defining it is a grammar, a grammar is a standard-shaped commitment, and the pack's own position (Wardley map W6) is to adopt one if it emerges rather than define one here.
consequence: excess authority and shortfall are computable in this registry only where grant and mandate name resources countably — which is why the grant's permits block carries resources_count. A real vocabulary makes the set difference real; this one makes it demonstrable.

capabilities.name: repo.pull-request.create
capabilities.means: open a pull request on the named repository
capabilities.origin: the pack's own candidate first capability (decision 6, proposed)

capabilities.name: repo.contents.write
capabilities.means: push commits to the named repository within the stated constraints

capabilities.name: vault.lane.append
capabilities.means: post one payload to the named append lane
capabilities.origin: fixture vocabulary — the shipped transport's write operation, named
